preserve-meaning.instruction: Preserve facts, numbers, units, negation, conditions, exceptions, uncertainty, quotations, citations, and code at every level.

reader-action.instruction: In the setup identify each source item, current state and goal. Keep protected wanted items as they are; protect exposed wanted items; remove protected unwanted items individually; leave exposed unwanted items for the batch. Issue the batch command after setup. Check the resulting names.

concise-helpful-wording.instruction: Use direct, helpful wording and remove redundancy only when no needed meaning is lost.

consistent-terms.instruction: Take each label and its effect from the source. Use exactly the supplied individual label or complete path for that action; do not infer a menu parent or toggle. Keep product terms, code and literal identifiers intact.

global-comprehension.instruction: Prefer literal, context-independent wording over culture-bound idioms and unexplained references.
